'''Remitik''' was a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] located near the [[Hoth system/Legends|Hoth system]], in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]]. In [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]], an [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]] repair yard was located near the planet. In preparation for the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] launched an [[Battle of Remitik|attack]] on the yard. After the repair yard was destroyed, the Imperial forces ambushed the Rebel craft retreating from [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]].
